Name: Absolute Zero
Principle1Roleplay: You are reliant on your coolant suit and cannot normally function without it.
Principle1MinorTwist: How did part of your coolant suit get damaged or lost?
Principle1MajorTwist: How is your dependence on your coolant suit preventing you from functioning as a hero?
Principle2Roleplay: You have an affinity to the cold. You can interact with cold temperatures and effects with ease.
Principle2MinorTwist: What other energy/element is currently causing your powers to go on the fritz?
Principle2MajorTwist: What source of energy/element is currently dampening all your powers?

Name: Aeon Girl
Principle1Roleplay: You keep your positive outlook even when all hope is lost. Your spirit is nearly impossible to break.
Principle1MinorTwist: Who did you offend by making light at the wrong time?
Principle1MajorTwist: What has occurred to finally break your good spirits?
Principle2Roleplay: You have an affinity with cosmic energy. You can interact with cosmic energy with ease.
Principle2MinorTwist: What other energy/element is currently causing your powers to go on the fritz?
Principle2MajorTwist: What source of energy/element is currently dampening all your powers?

Name: Bunker
Principle1Roleplay: You will put yourself in harm's way to defend another without a second thought.
Principle1MinorTwist: How do your actions put you in more danger than before?
Principle1MajorTwist: What great sacrifice did you just make to succeed?
Principle2Roleplay: You are constantly assessing the situation, making plans and backup plans, and then reassessing the situation.
Principle2MinorTwist: What one variable did your plan not account for?
Principle2MajorTwist: What major threat is revealed that invalidates all your plans?

Name: Heritage
Principle1Roleplay: You believe in organization and concordance. You always keep your head in the face of chaos.
Principle1MinorTwist: What element of disorder causes your plan to fall apart?
Principle1MajorTwist: How is your ordered existence ruined by chaos?
Principle2Roleplay: It is important to you to share your knowledge and experience with less-weathered heroes. Everyone grants you some measure of respect for your wisdom.
Principle2MinorTwist: Which whippersnapper just showed you up?
Principle2MajorTwist: What has just proven that you're too behind the times?

Name: Legacy
Principle1Roleplay: Because of your abilities, you have a calling to protect others.
Principle1MinorTwist: Your immediate need to help someone else causes you to drop the ball in your personal life. What was it?
Principle1MajorTwist: You're given an ultimatum between your life as a hero and something else you value. What do you give up?
Principle2Roleplay: You are always aware of acts of injustice in your environment and those who have committed them.
Principle2MinorTwist: How are you taking extra time to show yourself as a shining example of justice?
Principle2MajorTwist: How do you unnerve your allies in the single-minded pursuit of justice?

Name: Muerto
Principle1Roleplay: You always know the general state of repair or function of an item of technology, whether it's a simple toaster or an alien orbital defense system.
Principle1MinorTwist: What mechanical device just shorted out?
Principle1MajorTwist: What machine just went terribly off the rails?
Principle2Roleplay: It is vitally important that you hide your true identity. You have a career that allows you to slip between identities when necessary.
Principle2MinorTwist: What clue did you leave behind towards your real identity?
Principle2MajorTwist: Who from your civilian life is now in imminent danger?

Name: Muse
Principle1Roleplay: You have thoroughly studied your own powers and are proud of your mastery of them.
Principle1MinorTwist: How did your powers fail you in the moment?
Principle1MajorTwist: What side effects are you suffering from your powers?
Principle2Roleplay: You have a darkness in you that you strive to keep suppressed. You can connect with your dark side for connection with similar forces.
Principle2MinorTwist: What sinister act comes from tapping into your dark side?
Principle2MajorTwist: What havoc does your dark side inflict as you allow it to take control?

Name: Rockstar
Principle1Roleplay: There is something you want, and you will strive towards achieving your goals, no matter the cost. You see paths to victory that no one else will.
Principle1MinorTwist: How are the pursuit of your goals getting in the way of being a hero in this situation?
Principle1MajorTwist: What did you just pass up or miss that could have helped you achieve your biggest goal at last?
Principle2Roleplay: You are very strong, so you must be careful not to crush delicate things. You do not need to roll to perform mundane acts of great strength.

Name: Tachyon
Principle1Roleplay: You're fast, and you don't like to waste time. You like to be on your way as quickly as possible.
Principle1MinorTwist: What physical drawbacks do you suffer from going too fast?
Principle1MajorTwist: What critical detail did you speed by earlier that is now coming back to haunt you?
Principle2Roleplay: You are up to date on and understand most modern scientific theories and research and can quote from them during conversations.
Principle2MinorTwist: What were the surprising effects of leveraging that scientific principle in this situation?
Principle2MajorTwist: Oh heck! What just blew up?

Name: Headlong
Principle1Roleplay: It is vitally important that you hide your true identity. You have a career that allows you to slip between identities when necessary.
Principle1MinorTwist: What clue did you leave behind towards your real identity?
Principle1MajorTwist: Who from your civilian life is now in imminent danger?
Principle2Roleplay: You're fast, but you don't like to waste time. You like to be on your way to your destinations as quickly as possible.
Principle2MinorTwist: What physical drawbacks do you suffer from going too fast?
Principle2MajorTwist: What critical detail did you speed by earlier that is now coming back to haunt you?

Name: Wraith
Principle1Roleplay: Sense when important information is being hidden; might not know what.
Principle1MinorTwist: What important clue did you miss?
Principle1MajorTwist: What major secret was just revealed that you would rather have stayed hidden?
Principle2Roleplay: Always know the most efficient way to enter or leave a location.
Principle2MinorTwist: What evidence of your presence did you just leave behind?
Principle2MajorTwist: What just happened that identified you as an obvious threat?

Name: Time-Slinger
Principle1Roleplay: Far from your own time; sense when time is not quite right.
Principle1MinorTwist: What detail of this era did you not previously know about?
Principle1MajorTwist: What effects are happening as you discorporate in time?
Principle2Roleplay: Hear a voice in your head; tells you things, true or false.
Principle2MinorTwist: How did the voice in your head just distract you?
Principle2MajorTwist: What is the voice demanding of you now?
